intro: One row per bank. Each statement below was read directly from the official page linked in the same row during this session. Where a bank publishes multi-factor authentication or a security guarantee, it is quoted; where it does not, the cell is blank rather than inferred.

rows.app: Synchrony Bank mobile app, iOS and Android (page shows App Store 4.8 and Google Play 4.6 ratings)
rows.security: 24/7 transaction monitoring stated; customizable account alerts; FDIC insurance up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each ownership category
rows.notes: Synchrony's page describes 24/7 monitoring and alerts but does not print an MFA or passkey claim, so that cell is blank.

rows.app: Marcus mobile app (open and manage the account from a mobile device; app page linked from the official site)
rows.security: "Marcus protects your account with multi-factor authentication, SSL encryption, firewalls and other safeguards"; FDIC insured; 7-days-a-week contact center
rows.two_factor: Multi-factor authentication; SSL encryption; firewalls (Marcus security statement)
rows.notes: Compounding: Marcus states interest compounds daily.

rows.app: SoFi app: mobile check deposit, customizable alerts, 24/7 account access
rows.security: "We continuously monitor your account for suspicious activity to keep your money safe"; FDIC insurance advertised up to $3M through a network of participating banks
rows.notes: The $3M figure is a sweep-network program, not a single-bank $250,000 limit; see the FDIC Coverage page.

rows.app: American Express App ("award-winning" per Amex), iOS and Android
rows.security: 24/7 customer support; Member FDIC with each depositor insured to at least $250,000
rows.two_factor: Mandatory multi-factor authentication (customers cannot opt out); 128-bit SSL; automatic logout after 5 minutes of inactivity; email confirmation on password recovery; phone security Q&A
rows.notes: Amex states the APY is 'accurate as of 10/21/2026' in the disclosure on this page; that date is used for the APY-as-of column.

rows.app: Capital One Mobile app: mobile check deposit, AutoSave, 24/7 access
rows.security: "Banking security - Get online banking security features to help manage your money with confidence"; FDIC-insured up to allowable limits
rows.two_factor: Two-step authentication, biometric sign-in (face/fingerprint), real-time fraud and purchase alerts, in-app card lock
rows.notes: App features (biometric sign-in, alerts, card lock) are stated on Capital One's app page; two-step authentication is described there as one of its security features.

rows.app: Ally mobile banking app with savings buckets, boosters and charts
rows.security: "Online and mobile security guarantee": no liability for unauthorised online or mobile banking transactions if reported within 60 days of the statement being made available; MFA, TLS, automatic logout and account monitoring
rows.two_factor: Multi-factor authentication (security code to a registered device); TLS encryption; firewalls; antivirus/anti-malware; automatic logout; fraud monitoring
rows.notes: Guarantee conditions (60-day reporting window) are stated on Ally's security page.

rows.app: U.S. Bank mobile app with goal tracking and budgeting tools
rows.security: "Secure digital banking" - manage savings anytime with mobile and online banking; FDIC insured to the maximum allowed by law

rows.app: Wells Fargo mobile app (standard account management; mobile deposit)
rows.security: FDIC-insured up to the maximum applicable limit; a dedicated fraud-reporting path is published (see source link in nav)
rows.notes: App-store listings were not opened in this session.

rows.app: Bank of America Mobile Banking app (App Store and Google Play linked from the official page)
rows.security: FDIC-insured deposit products banner on the product page; FDIC coverage page published
rows.notes: Bank of America's fee schedule and savings pages do not print an MFA claim; the security center page was not opened in this session.

rows.app: Chase Mobile app: mobile check deposit, Autosave, bill pay, Zelle
rows.security: Chase states savings accounts are FDIC insured up to the maximum amount allowed by law

rows.app: Citi Mobile App; online banking; 65,000+ fee-free ATMs nationwide
rows.security: FDIC-insured savings stated on the product page

rows.app: TD Bank mobile app with TD Bank Mobile Deposit
rows.security: FDIC-insured savings stated on the product page
No security-feature statement appeared on the captured disclosure page
rows.notes: Truist's mobile app and security claims were not verified in this session; cells left blank rather than inferred.

rows.app: Schwab mobile apps with Schwab Mobile Deposit
rows.security: FDIC-insured savings up to $250,000; no ATM fees (rebates worldwide)
